name: pdpl-sa-sample
title: Saudi Arabia PDPL (sample pack)

controls.source: PDPL art. 1(8) and Implementing Regs. art. 25

controls.person: Provide a clear Arabic/English privacy notice stating purpose, lawful basis, retention and contact details before collecting personal data
Execute data processing agreements with processors and verify cross-border transfer adequacy or SDAIA exemptions
Notify SDAIA within 72 hours of a personal data breach and notify affected individuals where serious harm is likely
Conduct a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for high-risk or sensitive data processing
Appoint a Data Protection Officer (DPO) and register on the SDAIA National Data Governance Platform where required

notCovered: credit data and financial-sector SAMA rules (PDPL art. 24)
direct marketing opt-out workflows where not modelled in app consent (PDPL art. 25)
official SDAIA adequacy list verification for cross-border destinations
